rows.28:145e4:
"So you're awake."
That voice... Hosoda★
"Wh-why...?"
"I looked up your address in the school roster.
Forgetting to lock up... You're a careless one, aren't you?"
Giggling, Hosoda put his hand in his pocket.
What he pulled out was a fruit knife{f:.|.}
Even in the dark, I could see the blade glint.{p}
rows.28:16b30:
The girl sank her teeth into Hosoda's throat with a chomp.
She slurped up the blood as it gushed out.
Hosoda didn't move.
Were her fangs coated with poison, or some kind of anesthetic{f:?|?}
In no time at all she had drained him dry, and then the girl looked at {f:me|me}.
"I was drenched in my big brother's blood.
Ever since then, I can't stop craving blood."
Her eyes shimmered with an iridescent sheen.
I couldn't move.
{f:Had I|I must have} already fallen under her spell, too{f:...?|...}
As {f:I|I} stood there dazed, the girl drove her sharp fangs into my neck.{p}
